name: kt_init_single
what: Call kt_init() once, verify no crash
how: kt_init() returns void; no assertion except it doesn't segfault

name: kt_make_valid
how: kt_make("test", 800, 600) returns non-NULL A

name: kt_make_extreme
how: kt_make("tiny", 1, 1) returns non-NULL; kt_make("huge", 0, 0) returns NULL

name: kt_free_null
what: Free NULL session, verify null safety
how: kt_free(NULL) no-ops without crash

name: kt_free_then_reuse
how: kt_free(s0); s1 = kt_make("reborn", 320, 240); verify s1 != NULL and works

name: kt_free_double
how: kt_free(s); kt_free(s); second call is safe (no double-free)

name: kt_row_single
how: kt_row(s, -1, "box", "root") returns id=1

name: kt_row_nested
how: kt_row(parent=-1)→kt_row(parent=1)→kt_end_row→kt_end_row; verify child linked to parent

name: kt_row_stable_key
what: Reuse stable key returns same node
how: kt_row(s, -1, "box", "key1") returns id=1; kt_row(s, -1, "box", "key1") returns id=1 (not 2)

name: kt_row_depth_limit
how: kt_row nested 64 times; kt_end_row 64 times; no error

name: kt_row_depth_overflow
how: kt_row nested 65 times; error handler fires on 65th push; stack not corrupted

name: kt_text_content
how: kt_row→kt_text(s, e, "Hello")→kt_end_row; verify no crash, text stored correctly

name: kt_row_invalid_parent
what: Row with invalid parent index falls back gracefully
how: kt_row(s, 9999, "box", "orphan"); returns valid id (parent becomes root); no crash

name: kt_width_height
what: Set width and height on element
how: kt_width(s, e, 200.0); kt_height(s, e, 100.0); kt_end; kt_cmd_get(0).bounds.w == 200.0, .h == 100.0

name: kt_pad_layout
how: kt_pad(s, e, 10.0); child's bounds shift inward by 10px on all sides

name: kt_pad_xy_asymmetric
how: kt_pad_xy(s, e, 10.0, 20.0); horizontal pad=10, vertical pad=20

name: kt_gap_between
how: Two children under parent with kt_gap(s, p, 8.0); cmd bounds show 8px separation

name: kt_direction_column
how: kt_direction(s, e, KT_DIR_COLUMN); two children stack vertically, verify y-positions

name: kt_direction_row_reverse
how: kt_direction(s, e, KT_DIR_ROW_REVERSE); two children appear in reversed x-order

name: kt_fill_hex_color
what: Set fill color from hex string
how: kt_fill(s, e, "#21D4A1"); kt_end; cmd.color == 0xFF21D4A1 (premultiplied ARGB)

name: kt_fill_short_hex
how: kt_fill(s, e, "#FA0"); cmd.color computed == 0xFFFFAA00

name: kt_fill_named_color
what: Set fill from named theme color
how: kt_fill(s, e, "accent"); resolves to correct named color uint32 from theme table

name: kt_radius_corner
how: kt_radius(s, e, 8.0); kt_end; cmd.radius == 8.0 (or fixed-point equivalent)

name: kt_opacity_apply
how: kt_opacity(s, e, 0.5); fill with #FF0000; framebuffer pixel alpha is ~128 (premultiplied)

name: kt_stroke_rect
how: kt_stroke(s, e, "#FF0000", 2.0); kt_end; cmd.type == KT_CMD_STROKE, cmd.thickness == 2.0

name: kt_font_size
how: kt_font(s, e, 14.0); kt_text(s, e, "hi"); kt_end; cmd references correct font size (no crash)

name: kt_put_get_i64
how: kt_put(s, "counter", 42); let v = kt_get(s, "counter", -1); assert v == 42

name: kt_put_get_f64
how: kt_put_f(s, "pi", 3.14159); let v = kt_get_f(s, "pi", 0.0); assert abs(v - 3.14159) < 1e-6

name: kt_put_get_string
how: kt_put_s(s, "name", "hello"); let v = kt_get_s(s, "name", ""); assert v == "hello"

name: kt_get_fallback
what: Get returns default for missing key
how: kt_get(s, "nope", 42) returns 42; kt_get_f(s, "nope", 3.14) returns 3.14; kt_get_s(s, "nope", "def") returns "def"

name: kt_state_survives_frame
how: kt_put(s, "x", 1); kt_begin(s, 16); kt_end(s); kt_get(s, "x", 0) returns 1 (not 0)

name: kt_state_capacity_limit
how: fill 128 unique keys; 129th returns error or is silently dropped; no crash

name: kt_cmd_count_empty
how: kt_begin(s, 16); kt_end(s); kt_cmd_count(s) == 0

name: kt_cmd_count_filled
how: kt_begin; kt_row; kt_fill; kt_end_row; kt_end; kt_cmd_count(s) >= 1

name: kt_cmd_get_first
what: First command is KT_CMD_FILL with correct color
how: kt_fill(s, e, "#FF0000"); kt_end; kt_cmd_get(s, 0).type == KT_CMD_FILL; .color == 0xFFFF0000

name: kt_cmd_count_multi_frame
how: Frame 1: 1 cmd; Frame 2: 0 cmds; kt_cmd_count consistently returns per-frame count

name: kt_pixel_golden_match
how: Render known layout; compare g_fb byte-for-byte against golden/<test>.bin; 0 mismatches

name: kt_pixel_golden_mismatch
how: Render layout; compare against wrong golden; first mismatch byte > 0 (negative test)

name: kt_draw_merge_adjacent
what: Adjacent same-color fills auto-merge into one cmd
how: Two adjacent same-color rects; cmd_count < 2; merged cmd bounds covers both rects

name: kt_clip_single
how: CLIP at (10,10,100,100); FILL at (0,0,200,200); pixel at (5,5) is background (unwritten)

name: kt_clip_nested_parenthesis
how: CLIP(0,0,200,200)→CLIP(50,50,100,100); fill covers only intersection (50,50,100,100)

name: kt_clip_unclip_restore
how: CLIP(10,10,50,50); CLIP(200,200,10,10); UNCLIP; FILL; verify second clip released

name: kt_clip_stack_depth
how: Push 16 clips; verify each intersects correctly; no crash

name: kt_clip_stack_overflow
how: Push 17 clips; 17th clip is no-op; stack not corrupted; subsequent POP still works

name: kt_clip_degenerate
what: Degenerate clip (w=0 or h=0) suppresses fill
how: CLIP(10,10,0,0); FILL(0,0,800,600); no pixels written (all stay background)

name: kt_clip_framebuffer_edge
what: Clip at framebuffer edge clamped correctly
how: CLIP(-100,-50,1000,900); clamped to (0,0,800,600); fill works inside clamped region

name: stress_max_nodes
how: Create 4096 unique elements within session capacity; no crash, no alloc failure

name: stress_overflow_nodes
how: Create 4097 elements; error handler fires at 4097th; session state intact

name: stress_deep_tree
how: 1000 nested kt_row→kt_end_row pairs; tree integrity verified via cmd_count > 0

name: stress_multi_frame
how: 60 frames of kt_begin→random tree→kt_end; no accumulation, no leak, framebuffer valid

name: stress_large_framebuffer
how: triple/kt_make("big", 4096, 4096); single fill; kt_cmd_count >= 1; allocation not rejected

name: stress_oversized_fb
how: kt_make("too_big", 32000, 24000) returns NULL (allocation refused)

name: backend_register_null
how: kt_backend_register(s, "null", &vtable) returns 0 (success)

name: backend_select_null
how: kt_backend_register + kt_backend_select(s, "null") returns 0; subsequent frames use null

name: backend_select_bogus
how: kt_backend_select(s, "bogus_gpu") returns -1; no crash

name: backend_probe
what: Probe returns bitmask of registered backends
how: kt_backend_probe(s) returns non-zero after registering one backend

name: backend_register_terminal
how: kt_backend_register(s, "terminal", &term_vtable) returns 0

name: input_mouse_move
how: kt_input_mouse_move(s, 400, 300); next frame input.mouse_x == 400, input.mouse_y == 300

name: input_mouse_down_up
how: kt_input_mouse_down(s, 0); next frame mouse_down[0]==1; kt_input_mouse_up(s, 0); mouse_down[0]==0

name: input_key_down_up
how: kt_input_key_down(s, 0x41); keys_down[0x41]==1; kt_input_key_up(s, 0x41); keys_down[0x41]==0

name: input_scroll_accumulate
how: kt_input_scroll(s, 0.0, -120.0); next frame input.scroll_dy == -120.0

name: input_text_buffer
how: kt_input_text(s, "hello"); text_input == "hello", text_len == 5

name: should_close_null
how: kt_should_close(s) returns 0 (null backend has no close mechanism)
